migration.how: DVJoystick · DVChords · DVMouseStick · DVSenseStick · DVControls: every source (keys, gamepad, mouse, mic, camera) becomes the same stick model; the merger wires it to the participant, the field of influence and the net.
migration.why: Old-school joystick controls (ESDF·A/C·Space · IJKL; with K the core of combinations · arrows) that any input can emulate.
